name: topic_mastery
description: Private append-only practice evidence and rolling topic mastery for one Parle learner

user_id.description: Buildy account id of the learner who owns the practice result

session_id.description: Tutor session that produced this practice item

skill.description: Verified skill for the practice item

topic.description: Verified learning topic measured by the item; preserves the existing topic-level rolling score

theme.description: Broad situation or subject, such as work or appointments

language_point.description: Specific French grammar, vocabulary, or usage point measured by the item

language_point_key.description: Normalized grouping key for point-level mastery calculations

source.description: Whether the item was practice or an AI lesson mini-test

item_key.description: Stable item key within the tutor session

rolling_score.description: Deterministic average of the latest ten topic items, from 0 to 100

language_point_rolling_score.description: Deterministic average of the latest ten items for this language point, from 0 to 100
